findings.title: Public Training reconstruction can expand authority for the same historical submission
findings.root_cause: _canonical_attempt verifies only the self-consistency of caller-supplied values using public Training constructors. It trusts supplied learned_concept_ids and Stage/context as the historical submission boundary without binding them to the original ID/timestamp submission. Public reconstruction with constructor-valid expanded knowledge therefore remains canonical and is accepted by the Evaluation factory.
findings.impact: OBS-002 becomes permitted for an existing S1 submission that learned only CON-S1-HIGH; transplanting a later S3 context also authorizes LOC-001 for the same original S1 attempt ID, timestamp and user analysis. Both primary and contributor channels are affected.
